evidence.title: ANYmal in the Field: Solving Industrial Inspection of an Offshore HVDC Platform with a Quadrupedal Robot
evidence.publisher: Gehring et al.; ANYbotics and TenneT coauthors; Springer
evidence.locator: Sections 3.1, 4.3, 5, 6, 7; Figures 7 and 11; book chapter pp.247–260
evidence.claim: ANYmal B300 study reports more than 30 autonomous missions over two weeks and assesses 385 instruments, with 92%, 85%, 54% room-specific inspectability. Closed doors, fire rules, visibility and incomplete platform-control/long-distance integration constrain full service.
evidence.limitations: No per-room n, attempt/completion denominator, intervention/review time, accepted defect dispositions, full costs or retained operation. Supplier coauthorship; not independent telemetry. No numerical transfer to current ANYmal or US utility labor. Timing statistics are averages with sample size and distribution unspecified.
